levels.cloud_content:
# Range Shop SQL injection lab

This Training Instance contains four independent team services in one sandbox. Open the service assigned by your instructor:

- attacker1: http://10.20.10.11:8080/
- attacker2: http://10.20.10.12:8080/
- attacker3: http://10.20.10.13:8080/
- attacker4: http://10.20.10.14:8080/

Each service has its own database. Use the platform-issued SSH key and the `user-access` account to inspect and patch your assigned VM. The internal checker checks each team service independently. Complete the exercise and submit `finish-sqli-lab` when instructed by your instructor.
levels.local_content: This lab runs as one CyberRangeCZ sandbox with four team services and an internal checker. Open the assigned Training Instance.
